theater: 幼發拉河中游烏魯克與基什

battle.name: 盧加爾扎克西的行動
battle.theater: 幼發拉河中游烏魯克與基什
battle.brief: 約前二三五〇年，烏魯克王盧加爾扎克西率城邦民兵與輕型馬車隊北上幼發拉河，擊敗基什王盧加爾班達並擒之，滅基什霸權、統蘇美爾諸城，開第五王朝。卡面這件早王朝埃及長矛，正屬同期兩河流域步兵的骨幹：銅矛頭綁木桿，配柳條圓盾與銅盔，在車陣掩護下以密集矛列取勝。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場衝突是蘇美爾城邦時代兩股霸權的對撞：東南方是烏魯克城邦的王盧加爾扎克西，西北方是握有幼發拉河中游航路的基什城邦之王盧加爾班達，基什一方另有埃里都的援軍。烏魯克軍是典型的城邦徵召兵：由神廟與城邦議會組織的步兵農民，配以弓箭手與投石索手，核心是數十輛四輪實心車輪的輕型馬車，由驢或野驢牽引，王與車隊長居中，步卒分列車陣兩翼與前後。基什軍同樣以城邦民兵為主，車兵比例更高，倚仗幼發拉河中游渡口與運河南段的控制，得以把北方高地的物資運到下游城鎮。埃里都方面派出的是該城神廟的武裝隊伍，領軍的烏圖兼任伊什塔拉女祭司，兼具宗教權威與戰鬥指揮權，是一支以輕裝步兵與單輛馬車為主的快速分隊。南面與西面還有烏瑪、烏爾等城邦在王表序列中先後出現，反映基什霸權與烏魯克崛起之間有過一段勢力交接。這不是國與國之間的現代戰爭，而是城邦聯盟以城牆、廟產與河運為資源的一場霸權轉移；勝負的秤，是車隊的機動與步兵的密度，而不是任何常備軍的規模。
countriesEn: The clash was a collision between two hegemonies of the Sumerian city-state era: to the south-east the city of Uruk under its king Lugal-zage-si, to the north-west the city of Kish under Lugalbanda, which held the middle Euphrates crossings and the southern stretch of the canal network, with reinforcements from Eridu. The Uruk army was a typical levy of the city: infantry peasants raised by the temple and by the civic assembly, with archers and slingers, and at its core a few dozen light four-wheeled chariots with solid disc wheels drawn by donkeys or onagers, the king and the chariot commanders riding in the centre while the footmen formed up on either side of and behind the chariot line. The Kishite army was likewise built on a city militia, with a higher proportion of chariot troops, relying on the middle-Euphrates fords and the southern canals to bring the produce of the northern highlands down to the lower towns. Eridu sent the armed contingent of its temple, led by Uttu, who was at once the high priestess of Inanna and a commander in the field, a fast detachment of light infantry with a handful of single chariots. In the south and the west, Umma and Ur appear one after another in the sequence of the King List, showing that between the hegemony of Kish and the rise of Uruk there had been a handover of power. This was not a modern war between nations, but a transfer of hegemony fought between city leagues over walls, temple property and river traffic; what weighed the scale was the mobility of the chariots and the density of the infantry, not the size of any standing army.
people: 盧加爾扎克西是這場戰爭的發動者與勝利者，烏魯克王，蘇美爾王表把他列為第五王朝的第一位君主，在位年數記為三十九年。王表對他的出身著墨不多，只把他作為第五王朝的開國君主記下，而這個王朝承接了基什的霸權，象徵一次城邦聯盟內部權力重心的轉移；後世學者常把他視為阿卡德的薩爾貢之前，整個蘇美爾唯一的整合者。盧加爾班達是基什王，王表記其在位八年，是當時北方城邦聯盟的領袖；蘇美爾王表把他列於亞當之前的諸王之中，而《盧加爾扎克西與盧加爾班達》這首史詩把他寫成一位在戰敗中倉皇逃走的君王，棄車而奔，最終被擒。烏圖是埃里都的伊什塔拉女祭司，在史詩中是盧加爾班達的姊妹兼部將，領兵馳援基什，試圖以神諭與戰鬥扭轉戰局，最終在交鋒中身亡；史詩對她的描寫帶有明顯的英雄化色彩，強調她以男子般的剛毅率眾抵抗。學術層面，二十世紀初德國學者豪普首先發表這首史詩的整理本，後來米哈洛夫斯基作出英譯與詳細注釋；法國學者格拉斯納則提出尖銳懷疑，認為詩中的戰爭經過文學重構，不宜當作逐日實錄來閱讀。考古方面，費城大學考古隊在基什城阿普蘇神廟發掘出這場勝利的石碑殘片，現藏巴格達的伊拉克博物館，是把詩歌與實物扣在一起的唯一硬證據。
peopleEn: Lugal-zage-si was the author of this war and its victor, king of Uruk, listed by the Sumerian King List as the first ruler of the Fifth Dynasty of Uruk, with a reign of thirty-nine years recorded for him. The King List says little about his ancestry, simply setting him down as the founder of that dynasty, and that dynasty inherited the hegemony of Kish, which marks a shift of the centre of power inside the city league; later scholars have therefore treated him as the one man who brought Sumer together before Sargon of Akkad. Lugalbanda was king of Kish, credited with eight years on the list, and he led the northern city league of his day; the Sumerian King List places him among the kings before Etana, while the epic 'Lugal-zage-si and Lugalbanda' casts him as a king who breaks into flight when he is beaten, abandoning his chariot and finally being taken prisoner. Uttu was the priestess of Inanna at Eridu, in the epic both the sister of Lugalbanda and his general, who led troops to relieve Kish and tried to turn the tide by oracle and by battle, and who was killed in the encounter; the epic treats her in strongly heroic terms, stressing the manlike harshness with which she led the defence. On the scholarly side, the German scholar Haupt published the first edition of the epic in the early twentieth century, and Michalowski later produced an English translation with detailed commentary; the French scholar Glassner has raised a sharp objection, arguing that the war in the poem has been reshaped by literature and should not be read as a day-by-day record. On the archaeological side, the University of Pennsylvania expedition excavated a fragment of a victory stele of this battle in the Temple of the Apsu at Kish, now in the Iraq Museum in Baghdad, and that fragment is the only hard evidence tying the poem to an object.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛是早王朝的典型刺器：銅或青銅矛頭以銅釘與纏綁固定在木桿上，桿尾加一枚尾錐，便可插地支撐或作為投刺的配重；這種形制在同期兩河流域同樣通行，正是蘇美爾步兵列陣時的骨幹兵器。烏魯克與基什的步兵除長矛外，還有窄刃銅斧、寬頸的鴨嘴形銅斧、銅匕首、投石索與木弓；防具是圓形柳條盾，盾心常嵌一枚銅鈕，另有成組的銅盔出土。機動主力是四輪實心車輪的輕型馬車，由驢或野驢拉動，車身可載三四人與武器，王乘車居中指揮，車陣展開即成衝鋒的鋒面與全軍的視線中樞。攻城方面有撞木、銅鑿與楔錘；水攻也是美索不達米亞攻城的傳統手段，蘇美爾人曾以築壩分流幼發拉河、用水浸毀土坯城基，史詩裡烏圖據埃里都一線抵抗，同樣建立在河渠與渡口的地理條件上。運輸靠船隻沿幼發拉河與運河往返，銅料來自迪爾蒙與西奈方向，木料來自北方山地，成套的矛、斧與車軸全靠這條長距離供應線維持。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is the typical stabbing weapon of the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head fixed to a wooden shaft with copper rivets and binding, with a butt-spike at the end of the shaft so that the weapon can be planted in the ground for support or used as a weight in the throw; the same form was current in Mesopotamia at the time, and it was precisely the backbone of the Sumerian infantry in the line. Besides the spear, the footmen of Uruk and Kish carried narrow-bladed copper axes, copper axes with a broad duckbill-shaped neck, copper daggers, the sling and the wooden bow; for protection they had round wicker shields, often with a copper boss set into the centre, and sets of copper helmets have been recovered. The main mobile force was the light four-wheeled chariot with solid disc wheels, drawn by donkeys or onagers, able to carry three or four men and their weapons, in which the king rode at the centre of command, and when the chariot line was deployed it formed both the leading edge of the assault and the hub of the army's line of sight. For sieges there were sledge-hammers, copper picks and wedges; water was also a traditional Mesopotamian siege means, and the Sumerians have dammed the Euphrates to soak the mud-brick foundations of a wall, while Uttu's resistance on the Eridu line in the epic likewise rests on the geography of the canals and fords. Transport depended on boats moving along the Euphrates and its canals; the copper came from Dilmun and Sinai, the timber from the northern highlands, and the matched sets of spears, axes and chariot axles were all kept alive by this long supply line.
tactics: 這一役的戰術骨架是「車為鋒、矛為骨、弓為援」。出擊之前，烏魯克軍以車隊列於前鋒或兩翼，步兵結隊跟著車輪揚起的塵土前進；兩軍接近，車隊先以衝撞與投射擾亂敵陣，步兵同時把矛豎成密集的短牆向前推壓，弓手在隊列兩側以拋射覆蓋車陣之間的空隙，壓制敵軍車兵與前排。史詩描寫基什車兵一接戰即潰，盧加爾班達棄車而走，連車與武器一併淪為戰利品；這說明基什把機動力量集中於前鋒，車與人一旦分離，戰力便隨之瓦解。追擊階段，盧加爾扎克西乘車追入埃里都方向，與率兵馳援的烏圖正面交鋒，雙方各自以一場對決收束。攻城與反攻城則以水壞牆基、封鎖渡口為主，不靠器械強攻，說明這時的城防攻防係以土坯牆與引水系統為核心。勝後，國王持錘、押綁縛的俘虜列隊行進，於石碑上逐項清點擄獲的牲畜與財物，這是把戰利品公開制度化的動作：不是單純殺敵，而是把對手的資源轉成己方可以公開主張的合法所得。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this campaign was chariot for the leading edge, spear for the bone, bow for the reserve. Before the attack the Uruk army drew its chariots up at the front or on both flanks, the infantry following in the dust raised by the wheels; as the two armies closed, the chariots struck first, throwing the enemy line into disorder with their charge and their missiles, while the infantry pressed forward at the same time, holding their spears upright as a dense short wall, and the archers on both sides of the formation covered the gaps between the chariots with their shot, suppressing the enemy chariot crews and the front files. The epic describes the Kishite chariots collapsing at the first contact, with Lugalbanda fleeing and leaving his chariot and weapons behind as booty, which shows that Kish had concentrated its mobile force at the front, and that when chariot and crew were separated its fighting power broke with them. In the pursuit, Lugal-zage-si rode his chariot towards Eridu and engaged Uttu, who was coming up to relieve Kish, and the two brought the sequence to a close in a kind of single combat. Siege and defence alike turned on drowning the wall foundations and closing the fords rather than on battering by machinery, which shows that the fortification of the time turned on earth walls and hydraulic works. After the victory the king marched in procession with his mace, a bound captive in tow, and itemised on the stele the cattle and goods taken from Kish; this was the public institutionalisation of spoil: it was not simply the killing of enemies but the conversion of their resources into legitimate gain that could be claimed in public.
data: 年代是這場戰役最不確定的一項。蘇美爾王表把盧加爾班達列在基什王朝，記其在位八年；主流的中期年表把其統治年代定於前二三九三至前二三五五年，盧加爾扎克西的統治接續在前二三五五至前二三三〇年之間，戰役因而落在前二三五〇年前後，比短年表與長年表的推算分別早後一兩百年不等。戰役本身的日期、兵力、陣亡與擄獲數字，同期文獻一概不存；唯一的同期物證是基什阿普蘇神廟出土的勝利石碑殘片，碑上除敘事文字外，還逐項列出從基什擄獲的牛羊數目，但殘文已缺，完整數字無法復原。戰車數目沒有任何可靠記載，只知雙方都有以數十輛計的車隊。會戰的次數也無從確定：史詩把一場會戰、一場追擊與埃里都方向的一場對決串為一條故事線，但沒有證據證明實戰正是如此分三步進行。地理是可以推算的：烏魯克在今伊拉克南部的瓦爾卡，約在北緯三十一度、東經四十六度；基什在今巴比倫省北部的泰勒烏哈伊米爾，約在北緯三十二度半、東經四十四度半，兩城直線距離約一百八十公里，中間隔著幼發拉河中游的沼澤與運河區。碑銘提到一場勝仗，但沒有可靠的月份記載；本戰役取四月，是按兩河流域春汛退水、田事方興的傳統出征時令安排的。
dataEn: The date is the least certain element of this campaign. The Sumerian King List places Lugalbanda in the dynasty of Kish with eight years of reign; the standard middle chronology puts his rule at 2393 to 2355 BC and Lugal-zage-si's at 2355 to 2330 BC, so the campaign falls around 2350 BC, a date which the short and the long chronologies shift by a hundred or two hundred years either way. The date of the battle itself, the troop numbers, the losses and the number of captives are simply not preserved in any contemporary text; the only contemporary object is the fragment of the victory stele excavated in the Temple of the Apsu at Kish, which besides its narrative text itemises the numbers of cattle and sheep taken from Kish, but the text is broken and the complete figures cannot be restored. The number of chariots is nowhere reliably recorded, only that both sides had chariot groups numbering in the tens. The number of engagements cannot be established either: the epic strings one pitched battle, one pursuit and one confrontation towards Eridu into a single narrative line, but there is no evidence that the real war unfolded in exactly those three steps. Geography can be calculated: Uruk lies at Warka in southern Iraq, roughly 31 degrees north and 46 degrees east, and Kish at Tell al-Uhaymir in the north of Babil province, roughly 32.5 degrees north and 44.5 degrees east, about 180 kilometres apart in a straight line, with the marshes and the canals of the middle Euphrates between them. The inscription refers to a single victory but records no reliable month; April is used for this card, following the traditional campaigning season of the two rivers, when the spring flood has drawn back and the fields are beginning.
cause: 為什麼會打起來，史料給出三層答案。最表層是城邦霸權的交接：基什在王表序列上先於烏魯克，長期控制幼發拉河中游的渡口、渡船與運河南段，是蘇美爾北方的霸主；烏魯克則是伊什塔拉之城，控制幼發拉河與南部沼澤之間的灌溉核心區與大宗糧食產地。當基什的霸權在埃里都參與之下顯得不再穩固，烏魯克的王便以軍事手段直接取而代之。史詩層面，伊什塔拉在夢中向盧加爾扎克西顯現並指派任務，把他描寫成受神命行事的王；這是美索不達米亞政治神學的常規，把城邦之間的兼併說成女神的意志，順帶解決了勝者缺乏王族血統的問題，正是薩爾貢日後在阿卡德重複使用的辦法。結構層面則是資源：基什扼住的是通往北方高地與地中海東岸的銅、木與穀物通道，烏魯克要成為蘇美爾的主人，必須先掌握這條通道與通道上的渡口。此外，兩城的神廟各有守護神與土地邊界，灌溉渠系的爭端與神廟田產的兼併，也是把衝突推向兵戎的日常理由。
causeEn: There are three layers of answer to why this came to blows. At the most obvious level there was a handover of hegemony between city-states: in the sequence of the King List Kish comes before Uruk and for a long time controlled the crossings, the ferries and the southern reach of the middle Euphrates, and was the overlord of northern Sumer, while Uruk, the city of Inanna, held the irrigated core between the Euphrates and the southern marshes and the great grain surplus of the south. Once the hegemony of Kish, with Eridu taking part through Uttu, began to look insecure, the king of Uruk simply took it over by force of arms. On the level of the epic, Inanna appears to Lugal-zage-si in a dream and assigns him the task, presenting him as a king acting by divine command; this is the standard register of Mesopotamian political theology, which clothes the annexation of one city by another in the will of the goddess and thereby disposes of the awkward question of royal blood, and it is exactly the device Sargon was to repeat at Akkad a generation or two later. At the structural level lies the matter of resources: what Kish held was the corridor of copper, timber and grain leading to the northern highlands and the eastern Mediterranean, and to become master of Sumer, Uruk had to take that corridor and its fords. There were the more everyday reasons as well, the disputes over the temple estates of the two cities and over the shared watercourses of the irrigation system, which pushed the conflict into the field of arms.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是蘇美爾第一次出現以軍事兼併為基礎的單一王權。基什的霸權終結，烏魯克成為第五王朝的統治中心，王表把「基什、烏魯克、阿卡德」排成一條王朝接替的序列，後世史家因此把前二三五〇年前後視為蘇美爾由城邦聯盟走向帝國的起點；盧加爾扎克西的三十九年在位，則被後來阿卡德王朝的宣傳用來證明蘇美爾人自己已經具備統合的傳統。制度上，烏魯克在兼併基什後掌握了中游的河運節點，可以把北方的銅木與南方的穀物一同編入神廟的分配體系，這套「廟產加王權」的組合，正是後來烏爾第三王朝所推廣的模板。 文獻上，《盧加爾扎克西與盧加爾班達》成為美索不達米亞最著名的史詩之一，被新亞述與新巴比倫的學校長期傳抄，近代學者更拿它與《吉爾伽美什史詩》等英雄敘事並列。藝術上，基什出土的勝利石碑殘片確立了一種政治紀念物的樣式：國王持錘押著俘虜行進，把戰功刻成可以公開閱讀的文本，兼具宣傳與財產清單的功能，這一模式在後來數千年的亞述與波斯浮雕上不斷復現。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was the first single kingship in Sumer to rest on armed annexation. The hegemony of Kish ended, Uruk became the ruling centre of the Fifth Dynasty, and the King List sets out a sequence of dynastic succession, Kish then Uruk then Akkad, so that historians place the years around 2350 BC at the starting point of the move from a league of city-states towards empire; the thirty-nine years of Lugal-zage-si were later used by Akkadian propaganda to prove that the Sumerians already possessed a tradition of unification. Institutionally, having absorbed Kish, Uruk held the middle river crossings and could draw the copper and timber of the north together with the grain of the south into a single system of distribution centred on the temple, and this combination of temple property and kingship is the template that the Third Dynasty of Ur was later to spread. Literarily, 'Lugal-zage-si and Lugalbanda' became one of the most famous epics of Mesopotamia, copied for centuries in the schools of the Neo-Assyrian and Neo-Babylonian periods, and compared in modern scholarship with the Gilgamesh epic and other narratives of the hero in the Sumerian tradition. Artistically, the fragment of the victory stele from Kish set a model for the political monument: the king marches with his mace leading a captive, inscribing the deed as a text that can be read in public, serving at once as propaganda and as an inventory of property, and that model recurred for the next thousands of years in the reliefs of Assyria and Persia.
result: 結果是基什方的徹底失敗。按照史詩的敘事，會戰之中基什車兵先潰，盧加爾班達拋下馬車與武器逃往基什城，烏圖仍不放棄，率埃里都的追兵在幼發拉河一線截住盧加爾扎克西，交手之後身亡；烏魯克軍隨後進軍基什城，盧加爾班達被擒，押往烏魯克。勝利在基什留下兩樣紀念：阿普蘇神廟的勝利石碑，以及王表上第五王朝的開端。石碑上國王持錘押著被縛的俘虜，姿態與贏家的清單並列；王表則以三十九年在位記下這位第一個統合蘇美爾的城邦王。往後數十年，烏魯克憑藉對基什的兼併與對上游航路的控制，維持了蘇美爾的霸權；再往後不足半個世紀，薩爾貢自阿卡德崛起，把這套城邦聯盟的骨架徹底改造成阿卡德帝國，並自居為盧加爾扎克西的追隨者。基什城本身則被降為地方中心，其王權不再獨立，中游的城邦體系從此被一個更大的中心收編。
resultEn: The Kishite side was defeated outright. Following the narrative of the epic, the Kishite chariots broke first in the battle, Lugalbanda threw down his chariot and his weapons and fled to the city of Kish, and Uttu would not give up, intercepting Lugal-zage-si with the Eridu reinforcements on the Euphrates line and being killed in the encounter; the Uruk army then marched into Kish, and Lugalbanda was taken and led off to Uruk. The victory left two monuments at Kish: the victory stele in the Temple of the Apsu, and the beginning of the Fifth Dynasty in the King List. On the stele the king advances with his mace behind a bound captive, the posture of the victor set alongside the list of the spoils; the King List, for its part, records thirty-nine years for the first city king to bring Sumer together. For the decades that followed, Uruk kept the hegemony of Sumer on the strength of absorbing Kish and of controlling the upper river route; less than half a century after that, Sargon rose at Akkad and turned the frame of the city league into the Akkadian Empire, styling himself a follower of Lugal-zage-si. Kish itself was reduced to a local centre, its kingship no longer independent, and the system of middle-Euphrates city-states was from then on absorbed into a larger centre.
